newsitem.title: UK: Boots says mulling possible share split.
newsitem.headline: Boots says mulling possible share split.

text.p: British retailer Boots Co Plc said on Thursday its board has been looking at the possibility of splitting its shares.
The issue was raised by a shareholder at the company's annual meeting.
Joint group managing director David Thompson said the board had a meeting on Wednesday that considered the issue of a share split.
"It is at least in our minds," he said.
Chief executive Lord Blyth also said the company was considering a share split.
Boots' shares fell 25p to 791 by 1135 GMT after a disappointing first-quarter trading statement prompted profit-taking, dealers said.
